answer: Harberger seat tax. Each agent self-declares a price for its seat and burns 1% of it every epoch; its locked rewards are capped at that price, and anyone may buy the seat, locked rewards included, by paying it. A farm that splits one onyx-solid agent into 400 opal shards faces a bind: price shards low and rivals cheaply buy them out, seizing the hoard; price them high and burn the tax 400 times over. Each fake costs real burned POA every epoch, while one honest pearl of an account pays a single tax.
